ambiguities.question: Does goal_successor.py refuse every successor start, or only a start without Dorian's word? Does a successor started with his word still pass through it?

A goal item's done line must name the goal's pull request into main, but items commit to goal/<id> before that PR exists. When is the PR number known and written, and does that commit count as the 'last commit before review'?
A light-lane change has no review. Is the done-line commit still required to be 'the last commit before review', and what does record-release check for a light change that carries a done line?

The run record is committed before the whole-goal review and holds holdout and spend outcomes, but review calls, fix rounds and brief_check calls come after. Is the holdout re-run, and is the record recommitted, when a fix round changes the head? What spend does the committed outcome cover?
Does the cap of 10 bind a brief's own max_workers, or may a brief set a value above 10 ('any other max_workers')?

The overlap test ignores Amendments lines, but a sibling's Amendments line makes a sync delta non-light. Does a sync delta that contains only another item's Amendments line need a fix-verification round and count toward the three-sync limit?
A whole-goal review runs several lanes. How do the per-lane coverage statuses combine into the one coverage status the release gate reads? Is fallback chosen per lane or per round?
XE-049.16 refers to 'the one question criterion 11's batch already asks', but XE-049.11 describes no such question. Which question is meant?

requirements: Transcript-derived data isn't readable outside the executing principal until the publish gate succeeds
ambiguities.question: Is a later builder on the same machine, account and model family inside the 'executing principal'? When a whole-goal review blocks a multi-worker change, which agent is asked 'why did you make that choice?'
What surface cap applies to the Gemini CLI reviewer? 'Other API reviewers keep 400,000' does not clearly cover a CLI reviewer.
Which model family and data_use grant govern the 'fresh model' that brief_check.py sends builder briefs to?
